Sigma Beam System Designer EN 1993-1-3 · main beam + secondary SB-Int / SB-End

Floor element (panel, grating, MDF) → secondary beams → main beam → column → base → floor slab. SB-Int secondaries frame into the main beam; SB-End secondaries frame into the columns. Restraints, panels and connections are credited only when their stiffness and strength are demonstrated. Same calculations as the Excel workbook (revision 12): separate input tabs for the main beam, SB-Int, SB-End, the connections, joist beams, knee bracing (one L-section or two L-sections back-to-back, each with its own bolts, pitch, gauge, edge / end distance and hole; fastener types and washers), the surface / decking (lateral and torsional restraint demonstrated separately) and bracing & connections; every value the tool calculates shown as “Calculated = …” and kept apart from user input; every check explained (action, resistance, equation, steps, inputs, mechanism, reason, remedies); the main-beam L_LT shown with the restraint points actually credited and why; the connection stiffness calculated back from its geometry; failure diagnosis, what-to-change investigation and the SB-Int spacing for a target utilisation (inputs are never changed automatically); bays and modules with the load chain, direct welds at the top and bottom of built-up pairs, bolt groups nv × nh placed from the first bolt below the top of the section, the omega L-cleat through the main-web holes, restraints credited only when demonstrated (with their basis), live finite-strip kdist, failure cards with the reason, remedy and a link to the governing input, and a printable complete design report.

Inputs Design

Units: dimensions mm; area loads kg/m² (converted to kN/m²); forces kN; moments kN·m; stresses N/mm²; stiffness kN/mm (lateral) and kN·cm/rad (rotational; panel Cθ in kN·cm/cm/rad). Automatic values (C1, k_dist, L_LT, restraint spacings, support fixity, tributary widths, tab height and spacing, the Sigma middle band) are calculated and are not inputs; they are listed on the design tabs.

Hand-method implementation of EN 1993-1-3 with EN 1993-1-1 (incl. Annex BB.2), EN 1993-1-5, EN 1993-1-8 and EN 1990; nodal-brace requirements from AISC 360-16 Appendix 6. Loads are example values. Results are for checking and must be verified by a qualified engineer.
